title: OrderLinePicked
description: Published by Click and Collect after every accepted pick on an order line. Despite the name it is not limited to a completed pick: it is published for a partial pick that leaves the line PENDING and for an out-of-stock pick of quantity zero that sets the line UNAVAILABLE. The resulting line status is not carried, so pickedQty is a running value rather than a completion signal. Messages on this topic are not ordered.

orderId.description: Internal id of the order the line belongs to

orderLineId.description: Id of the picked order line

businessUnitId.description: Id of the business unit the pick was made in

pickedQty.description: Quantity recorded for the line by this pick. Zero is a valid value and signals the item was unavailable

pickedBy.description: User profile id of the picker. Absent when the originating request carried no user identity

pickedAt.description: Time the event was published, not the time the picker acted. A replayed message carries the replay time
